title: Synthetic Media Disclosure Log
description: A log of mass communications that used AI-generated voice or likeness content, recording whether the required disclosure was applied and any detection-system findings.
evidence_description: A record of every outbound mass communication identified (by automated detection or self-declaration) as using AI-generated voice or likeness content, whether the required disclosure was applied, and the outcome of any review.
collection_method: Automated detection system output combined with sender self-declaration at submission time.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, longer where required by election-law record-keeping rules.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of flagged communications and disclosure status.

citations.title: FCC Makes AI-Generated Voices in Robocalls Illegal
